title: Canyons 100M — Canyons Endurance Runs by UTMB 2027
publisher: UTMB World Series / Canyons Endurance Runs by UTMB
claims: The 100M is 100 miles with 18,208 ft+ of gain, starts at China Wall Trailhead on Friday 23 April 2027 at 12:00 and has a 35-hour limit; it carries 4 Running Stones.
The course description says the route has approximately 18,000 ft of gain and 22,000 ft of descent.
After No Hands Bridge the 100M adds the K2 climb, Cool, the Coffer loop, the Olmstead loop and a return through Brown's Bar and American Canyon before finishing in downtown Auburn.
